BucketCacheOk hash seed round cache: every stored entry (b, src) has src = hash (bucketPreimage seed round b). Preserved under insert-if-absent (sourceCacheStep_preserves).
bucketCacheGet_nil (empty cache returns none); bucketCacheGet_singleton (single-entry match returns some).

shuffleStep_source_eq_cache: shuffleStep's source term equals the fresh cache-step digest under BucketCacheOk (lets one substitute the cache in the walk).
